# Pesher Habakkuk Column 10 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Pesher Habakkuk Column 10 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 10:8-9 — "abused" vs. "mistreated" vs. "took terrible revenge"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "abused-him" | General term |
| LOGOS | "mistreated him" | Formal synonym |
| PNEUMA | "took terrible revenge on him" | Dynamic expansion |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "mistreated him." Neutral and accurate; PNEUMA adds "terrible" not in the Hebrew.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 10:16 — "to afflict him" vs. "to humble him" vs. "who humiliated him"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "to-afflict-him" | Hebrew le'annoto |
| LOGOS | "to humble him" | Formal rendering |
| PNEUMA | "who humiliated him" | Dynamic; changes clause structure |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "to afflict him" (EMET). More comprehensive than "humble" — includes physical suffering described in context.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 10:17 — "destroying blow" vs. "crushing defeat"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "a-destroying-blow" | Hebrew makkat kalah |
| LOGOS | "a destroying blow" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "a crushing, agonizing defeat" | Dynamic expansion |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "a destroying blow" (EMET/LOGOS). PNEUMA adds "agonizing" not in the text.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---
*Total disagreements in Column 10: 3 | Covers Hab 2:7-8*
